entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy, I'm calling because I'd like to return an Aero Road Helmet I purchased.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the helmet. And I see you're one of our VIP members, Ms. Chen. We appreciate your business.
Thanks. Is it too late to return it? I've had it for a bit.
Let's see here... it looks like it was delivered 81 days ago. According to our policy, you have a full **10 days** to make a return, so it's **no problem** at all.
Oh, that's a relief! I thought I might have missed the window. That's great news.
Happy to help! I can go ahead and email you a prepaid **return label** right now. Once you receive it, just attach it to the box and drop it at any shipping center.
That's perfect. That was surprisingly easy.

We try to make it simple. And just as a little thank you for being a VIP with us, I've added a free expedited shipping voucher to your account for your next purchase. The return label is on its way to your email now. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Wow, thank you! That's very generous. No, that's everything. I appreciate your help, Judy.
You're most welcome, Ms. Chen. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
